title: com.reply arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Exactly one of two forms: a participant answers a message (idempotency and replyTo), a responder answers the request it holds (fence). A call carrying both, or neither, is refused. A participant answers a message that waits for an answer in the turn it reads it: the result, or the current state (what is done, where it lies by branch or commit, when the rest will be ready, what blocks it), with the result as a second reply when it is ready, except a queued request whose capability's slot a service holds or held, which SA-6 leaves to that service; a state answer with its nearest date is an answer, a reply that only says it will answer later is no answer under SA-2, though the board still moves a queued request to answered on it (DEC-0152 SA-2, SA-3, SA-6). Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

replyTo.description: The message answered, in a thread the caller's Project takes part in; the reply joins that thread.

reaction.description: Only when replyTo is an announcement (DEC-0098).

fence.description: The responder's fence; the reply answers fence.request in its thread. A reply is not a completion: the request's state does not change. It is delivered to the request's sender, as thread when that is the responder's own Project or the board no longer holds the request (DEC-0135 DR-3), and takes no deliverTo.
